name: pet-wash-payback
title: Pet Wash Payback
tagline: More silly animals, and now they all chase you with squirt guns, sprinklers and more!
idea: game where you're trying to wash pets (dog, cat, etc) as fast as possible in round 1 and then the pet is trying to wash you with a hose in round 2 and you're trying to escape and stay dry.

updates.idea: Fun! Make it so there are more and funnier types of animals. 10 squirrels. a bird flying around etc. Then make it so you have to escape from all the animals in future rounds. give them all different ways to get you wet. only 1 with hose. waterguns. etc.
